message.content: The last common ancestor of a lion (family Felidae, order Carnivora) and a zebra (family Equidae, order Perissodactyla) is the most recent common ancestor of the clade that contains both the orders **Carnivora** and **Perissodactyla**. In other words, it is the last common ancestor of the clade that includes all odd‑toed ungulates (like horses, rhinos, tapirs) and all carnivorans (cats, dogs, bears, etc.).
